description: Business validation rules for camt.053.001.10 (Bank to Customer Statement)

rules.suggestion: Entry amount must be greater than zero. Use the CdtDbtInd field to indicate credit or debit direction.
examples: Invalid: <Amt Ccy="EUR">-500.00</Amt> (use positive amount with DBIT indicator)

rules.description: Entry amount must respect currency decimal precision
rules.suggestion: Ensure the number of decimal places matches the currency's standard precision. For example, USD/EUR use 2 decimals, JPY uses 0 decimals, BHD uses 3 decimals.
Balance amount should be non-negative. Use the CdtDbtInd field to indicate credit (positive) or debit (negative/overdrawn) balance.

rules.description: Value date must not be in the future
rules.suggestion: Value date must be today or in the past for end-of-day statements. Future value dates are not valid.

rules.description: Booking date must not be in the future
rules.suggestion: Booking date must be today or in the past. Future booking dates are not valid for completed transactions.

rules.description: Statement creation timestamp must not be in the future
rules.suggestion: Statement creation date/time should be the current timestamp or earlier. Future timestamps are not valid.

rules.description: Entry currency code must be a valid ISO 4217 currency code
rules.suggestion: Ensure the currency code is a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

rules.description: Balance currency code must be a valid ISO 4217 currency code
rules.suggestion: Ensure the currency code is a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

rules.description: Account IBAN must be valid when present
rules.suggestion: IBAN must follow ISO 13616 format with valid country code and Mod-97 check digits.

rules.description: Statement identification must be present and non-empty
rules.suggestion: Statement ID is mandatory and must uniquely identify this account statement.

rules.description: Entry reference must be present for each entry
rules.suggestion: Each entry must have a unique reference for tracking and reconciliation purposes.
Account identification (IBAN or other ID) must be specified to identify which account this statement covers.
Statement must include an opening balance (OPBD - Opening Booked) to establish the starting position.
Statement must include a closing balance (CLBD - Closing Booked) to establish the ending position.

rules.description: Balance consistency check - closing balance must equal opening balance plus net entries
rules.suggestion: The closing balance must equal the opening balance plus all credit entries minus all debit entries. Verify all entries are included and amounts are correct.
examples: Opening: 5000 EUR, Credits: +1000 EUR, Debits: -500 EUR, Closing must be: 5500 EUR

rules.description: Total entry count must match actual entry count when present
rules.suggestion: The total entry count in TxsSummary must match the actual number of entries in the statement.

rules.description: Total debit sum must match sum of all debit entry amounts when present
rules.suggestion: The total debit sum in TxsSummary must equal the sum of all debit entry amounts in the statement.

rules.description: Total credit sum must match sum of all credit entry amounts when present
rules.suggestion: The total credit sum in TxsSummary must equal the sum of all credit entry amounts in the statement.
